title: Concentric cylinders: profiles against the exact solution
caption: Circular Couette flow of the micropolar fluid between concentric cylinders (R1 = 4 g, R2 = 5 g, rotor at Omega, w = 0 on both walls): bin means of the azimuthal velocity (a, b) and of the micro-rotation (c, d) over the last quarter of the run (bins of one dx, about forty shown; every bin in the insets, which cover the 0.08 g next to the rotor and to the stator) against the exact solution (line). (a, c) K = 3, l = 25 dx, m = 2, g = 100 dx, Ma = 0.02, Re = 10 on mu_inf (25 on mu), run `g100_k3_m2`; (b, d) K = 3, l = 10 dx, m = 10, g = 200 dx, Ma = 0.02, Re = 10 on mu_inf (25 on mu), run `g200_k3_m10`. Tag `thesis-ch5-rc1`. Rms deviation from the exact profile, relative to the rms of the profile: m = 2: v 6.2e-05 in the core and 7.5e-04 within h of a wall, w 2.9e-03 and 5.6e-03; m = 10: v 1.7e-04 in the core and 3.4e-04 within h of a wall, w 2.0e-03 and 9.3e-03.
